payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort d in descending order, verify each distinct value appears exactly twice, then iteratively reconstruct absolute values a_i using derived linear equations based on the sum of absolute differences.
payload.rationale: The solution heavily relies on sorting to group identical d_i values and process them in descending order, which is necessary to compute the original symmetric array elements. No other algorithm families (like binary search or sweep line) are present.
